Hi Ava — welcome and congrats on the pilot win. I’ve copied Kimberly (AP) and Karthik (vendor onboarding) to coordinate intake.

Minimum fields we need to create a canonical vendor entity in our system:
- Legal entity name (exactly as on tax docs)
- Tax ID / EIN
- Registered address and remit address (if different)
- Primary AP contact name/email/phone and backup contact
- W-9 (signed) or equivalent tax form for non-US entities
- Bank authorization or ACH template for direct deposit (if you want electronic payment)

I’m attaching our vendor intake spreadsheet — please populate the shaded fields and return. If you prefer, we can accept the data in the format you already sent, but the intake form maps directly into our ERP fields which speeds setup.

Next steps:
1) Fill the attached vendor_intake_form_helix.xlsx and return (preferred).
2) Send signed W-9 and bank authorization PDF to kimberly_park@redwood.com.
3) Once AP confirms bank auth, we’ll create the vendor record and provide the Redwood vendor ID and preferred PO routing.

Timing: if we get documents by end of day tomorrow (Thu 7/22), we should be able to provision the record and route the first pilot PO next week.

Hi Ava — Kim from AP here. A couple quick notes on bank auth and remit: we accept a completed ACH authorization form OR a bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account name, routing, and account number. We need the remittance name to match the legal entity exactly.

For compliance and to avoid routing delays please provide:
- Bank letter or completed ACH template (PDF)
- Confirmation of legal entity as it should appear in our system (full punctuation and LLC/Inc suffixes matter)
- Point of contact for invoicing and a billing email address that will be used on supplier invoices

Please send the items to finance@redwood.com and cc me. I’ll hold off creating payment instructions until we verify the bank authorization.

On another note, some vendors prefer a PO-only workflow with invoice submission to finance@redwood.com; others request auto-pay. Let us know your preference in the intake form.
